# Expected Python test files, one path per line (`#` comments and blanks ignored).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# --------------------
# The CI step enumerates Python tests with `find` instead of a hardcoded list, because
# BMAD updates move, rename and retire skill directories wholesale — a stale hardcoded
# list produced `pytest: exit 4` for six weeks (commit a16fa340, 2026-06-27).
#
# But mechanical discovery alone only detects TOTAL annihilation. Code review on
# 2026-08-10 found the real regression it had already missed: discovery silently
# collapsed from 5 files to 1 and CI reported green — a loud failure traded for a quiet
# 80% coverage loss. This file is the baseline that makes a partial collapse loud.
#
# CI fails if any path listed here is NOT discovered. Extra discovered files are
# reported but do not fail, so a new upstream suite is surfaced rather than blocked.
#
# HOW TO UPDATE
# -------------
# When upstream legitimately retires a test, delete its line here IN THE SAME COMMIT
# that observes the retirement, with the reason in the commit message. Never edit this
# file to make a red build green without establishing why the file disappeared.
#
# Retired 2026-06-27 by BMAD update a16fa340 (renamed to `*.py.bak` upstream, and their
# implementation scripts retired with them — bmad-init and the BMB merge/cleanup
# helpers no longer exist):
#   _bmad/bmb/skills/bmad-builder-setup/scripts/tests/test-merge-config.py
#   _bmad/bmb/skills/bmad-builder-setup/scripts/tests/test-merge-help-csv.py
#   _bmad/bmb/skills/bmad-builder-setup/scripts/tests/test-cleanup-legacy.py
#   _bmad/core/bmad-init/scripts/tests/test_bmad_init.py

_bmad/core/skills/bmad-distillator/scripts/tests/test_analyze_sources.py
